policies.text: A product is awarded standard safety clearance provided it fulfills baseline shock absorption criteria.
An offering qualifies for master inventory listing when it receives retail distribution authorization and carries vendor indemnity coverage of no less than 1,500,000 USD annually.
A product is approved for store shelf rollout provided it has achieved master inventory listing.
A visor is cleared for field service operations if its projectile protection metric reaches at least 550 m/s.
A helmet gains retail distribution authorization if it holds standard safety clearance and maintains a strap tensile strength rating of at least 200 newtons.
A medical device gains hospital procurement sanction when its operational acoustic emission stays below 40 decibels.
An item meets baseline shock absorption criteria when its collision energy dissipation rating is at least 80 points alongside a penetration deflection value of no less than 35 points.
A maritime vessel receives open-water navigation permit if its hull thickness measures at least 25 millimeters and it carries automated location transmitters.
